integrity: The claimed global convexity and sharp threshold are supported by the analytic proof and a reproducible finite diagnostic program. Finite sampling does not verify a continuum theorem, and no independent scientific audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: One-dimensional driftless Brownian motion, same-position instantaneous complete resets, two independent exponential clocks, positive fixed feedback rate, target at a finite positive distance. No claims for reset costs, drift, delayed actions or arbitrary clock distributions. Generic renewal and source first-passage formula are pre-existing; a general unindexed result may affect publication priority.
title: Strict convexity and a sharp blind-restart threshold for feedback-reset Brownian search
